gc_policy: disabled only inside timed batches; restored after each batch
scope: Local 2/3 scheduler and shared source-incidence stage only; no full recognizer speed claim.

methods.source: q 1-4 moves, choosing least (boundary corner count, tetrahedron ID)
methods.ordering: independently randomized order within every timed pair
methods.batching: per-method pilot calibration; at most 2048 calls per batch
methods.geometry: constructed and independently source-authenticated once per case, outside timings
methods.scan: original full sorted scan and full candidate-list filtering; exterior endpoints omitted
methods.normalization: scan output normalization excluded; queue survivor output and counters included
methods.combined: both rebuild the same source endpoint packet; scan then drops exterior markers
methods.limitations: shared-host Python timings; geometric construction, source-proof authentication and terminal recognition excluded
